description: This file defines the 'AuditSection' class, a Java embeddable entity used for tracking audit information such as creation and modification dates and the user who modified the entity. It includes getter and setter methods, using a utility class 'CloneUtils' for cloning Date objects.

classes.name: AuditSection
classes.description: A serializable Java class annotated with @Embeddable, representing audit metadata with timestamps and user information, used within a persistence context.

methods.name: getDateCreated
methods.description: Returns a clone of the creation date to prevent external modifications.

methods.name: setDateCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation date, cloning the input date to avoid mutable external references.

methods.name: getDateModified
methods.description: Returns a clone of the modification date.

methods.name: setDateModified
methods.description: Sets the modification date with a clone of the input.

methods.name: getModifiedBy
methods.description: Returns the username or identifier of the last modifier.

methods.name: setModifiedBy
methods.description: Sets the username or identifier of the last modifier.
